title: MusicDrop v1.3.7 Available
changelog:
• Status Bar & Header Clearance: Fixed mobile header overlapping system clock and status bar time with safe display cutout and bright white status bar text
• Vinyl Turntable Theme: Added authentic rotating grooved black vinyl record with center album artwork label and animated metallic tonearm needle
• Radial Ring Up Next Drawer: Added circular progress ring with elapsed time counter, flanking skip controls, and bottom queue drawer sheet with floating amber play button
• HD Video Mode & Floating Screen: Smooth video playback with dedicated Floating Screen (PiP) picture-in-picture mode support
